# Fitting

```{python}
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit

# 定义多变量拟合函数
def func(X, a, b, c):
    x1, x2 = X
    return a * x1 + b * x2 + c

# 生成数据
x1 = np.linspace(0, 1, 10)
x2 = np.linspace(0, 2, 10)
X = np.array([x1, x2])
y = func(X, 1, 2, 3) + 0.1 * np.random.normal(size=x1.size)

# 使用 curve_fit 进行拟合
popt, pcov = curve_fit(func, X, y)

print("Optimal parameters:", popt)
```
